# VG247

> VG247 is a comprehensive gaming news and guides platform covering major AAA titles, indie games, mobile gaming, and live service games with reviews, walkthroughs, and promo code databases.

VG247 provides up-to-date gaming journalism, in-depth guides for popular titles across PC, console, and mobile platforms, and curated collections of working promo codes for free-to-play games. The site serves both casual and hardcore gamers with news coverage, expert reviews, and community resources.
